text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити is training hard for the
Japanese Derby.
She's in great shape so
far.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She learns that Тамамо Кросс has
suffered an
injury and goes to check on
her. It's painful seeing
Тамамо Кросс run
in her current state, but her
unrivaled
ambition for victory hasn't faltered.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс knows of Голд Сити's
success in the
Satsuki Sho and refuses to
lose against her. She
remains determined
to overcome any adversity
with her own
two feet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The determination on display emboldens
Gold
City, and she strengthens her
resolve to win the
upcoming Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
